abstract: The necropsy records of 78 patients with histologically proved germ cell tumors of the testis, who died as a direct result of their malignant disease, were reviewed to determine the usual modes of spread, distribution of metastasis, the histologic characteristics of the metastatic foci as compared with the morphology of the primary tumor and the specific cause of death. The sites of metastases in order of decreasing frequency for all cases were lung, retroperitoneal lymph nodes, liver, mediastinal lymph nodes, brain, kidney, gastrointestinal tract, bones, adrenals, peritoneum and spleen. The absence of metastases solely in the anterior mediastinum without involvement of other mediastinal nodes (middle/posterior) strongly supports the premise for a primary extragonadal origin whenever the anterior mediastinum alone is involved with malignant disease having the histologic appearance of a primary germ cell tumor. The histologic features of the metastatic lesions were usually similar in nature to those of the primary tumor except for seminoma in which the metastatic lesions proved to be of a different histologic pattern in almost one third of the patients dying from the disease. It should be axiomatic that whenever a patient with seminoma fails to respond appropriately to radiotherapy that his treatment be immediately discontinued and that appropriate biopsies be obtained to substantiate the histologic pattern present.
abstract_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的所見を有し、その悪性疾患により直接死亡した78例の剖検記録を検討した。転移の伝播様式、転移分布、転移巣の組織学的特徴、および死因を明らかにすることを目的とした。転移部位は頻度の高い順に肺、後腹膜リンパ節、肝臓、縦隔リンパ節、脳、腎臓、消化管、骨、副腎、腹膜、脾臓であった。前縦隔のみに病変があり、中・後縦隔リンパ節に病変がない場合は、性腺外原発を強く支持する。転移巣の組織像は、セミノーマを除き原発腫瘍とほぼ同様であった。セミノーマ患者のほぼ3分の1では、転移巣が異なる組織像を示した。セミノーマ患者が放射線療法に適切に反応しない場合は、直ちに治療を中止し、組織像を確認するための適切な生検を行うべきである。
